t: You're standing in Camden Market, really a cluster of adjoining markets in the old Pickfords stables, just north of the Hampstead Road Lock on the Regent's Canal. Stalls sell crafts, clothing, books, bric-a-brac and fast food, and around 250,000 people come through each week, making it the fourth most popular visitor attraction in London. It's often called Camden Lock. Among those born here is Gus Jaspert, a British diplomat who served as Governor of the British Virgin Islands from August 2017 to January 2021.
